subject: design-technology
title: Testing & Feedback
welcome_lead: Test with real users, listen, improve.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: user testing, feedback, prototypes.
final_note: Test early, test often, listen to users.

concepts.def: Early working version of a design.
Letting real users try a prototype.

walkthroughs.body_html: Build a prototype — even from cardboard — before making the real thing. Prototypes spot problems early when they are cheap to fix.
Give your prototype to real users. Watch them use it. Ask them questions (a questionnaire helps). Their feedback often surprises you — assumptions get challenged.
Use feedback to build version 2 — an iteration. Test that. Iterate again. Most successful products are version 5 or version 50, not version 1.

numericals.q: Roughly how many iterations may successful products go through?
